_comment: https://github.com/rolldown/rolldown/issues/10069 - two entries reach the same external through the same eliminated re-export shim, and a third only imports a name from it. Each cjs chunk emits its own `require`, so each decides the interop wrapper on its own. The two default-importing chunks wrap; `named-user` must not, because it holds no observer of the external as an ES module and `__toESM` is not identity- or descriptor-transparent (see `chunk_recorded_external_interop`). `_test.mjs` asserts all three read the right values either way.
